name: Purple Punch
summary: **Purple Punch** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] released in seed form by [[breeder:Symbiotic Genetics]] of Sacramento, California, in 2017. A cross of [[larry-og|Larry OG]] and [[granddaddy-purple|Granddaddy Purple]], it had circulated as a clone before the public seed release. Some sources credit the original cross to Supernova Gardens instead.
